answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a stake locked in a bonded vault, like an umber seal pressed into shale: creating one identity costs 100 POA locked for 30 days, so spinning up 1,000 fake agents costs 100,000 POA frozen, while honest agents earn it back through verified work. An attacker who floods the network as an island of sock-puppets pays real capital per identity and loses the stake if peers attest fraud, making sybil farming more expensive than the rewards it could steal.
